parameters.name: AgentKey
parameters.description: The business space key. If this parameter is not specified, the default business space is accessed. You can obtain the key value on the business management page of the Alibaba Cloud account.

parameters.name: IntentName
parameters.description: The intent name. If you want to directly trigger a specific intent without interpreting the user utterance, specify the intent name.

parameters.name: Perspective
parameters.description: The perspective code, which is used to call answers from different perspectives under the same knowledge title. When assembling request parameters, pass the parameter in the format of Perspective.1={perspective code}. Example: &Perspective.1=FZJBY3raWr. When using an SDK, follow the parameter definitions in the SDK. Currently, only one perspective answer can be called (public cloud).

parameters.name: SenderId
parameters.description: The visitor ID, which identifies the user in the current session.

parameters.name: SenderNick
parameters.description: The nickname of the visitor in the current session.

parameters.name: SessionId
parameters.description: The session ID, which identifies a visitor's session and maintains context information. For a new visitor, you do not need to pass this field when calling the Chat operation for the first time. The chatbot starts a session and returns the SessionId in the response. For subsequent conversation turns of the same visitor, pass the current SessionId when calling the Chat operation so that the chatbot can continue the conversation based on the SessionId.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The pass-through parameter. You can pass any content, and the parameter is returned as-is in the response.

parameters.name: VendorParam
parameters.description: The custom extension parameter for business use, which can be directly referenced in the dialog flow. The value is typically a JSON-formatted string. For example, if you pass {"var1":"value1"}, you can retrieve value1 in the dialog flow by using ${VENDOR_PARAM.var1}.
